description.fun: Lapras is gentle, clever and understands human speech, and it loves ferrying people across the water on its back. That kindness once made it easy prey for hunters, and it was nearly wiped out; protection worked so well that in some places there are now too many Lapras, and fish Pokémon are suffering. Pods sing to keep in touch, usually when they're in a good mood.
description.guide: A blue, plesiosaur-like Water and Ice Pokémon with a knobbly grey shell, known for carrying people across water. It does not evolve. It was once hunted almost to extinction but is now plentiful, and it can Gigantamax.
description.tagline: A gentle, singing ferry that understands you

description.fun: Gigantamax Lapras becomes something like a cruise ship, circled by a ring of ice particles that looks like a sheet of music, and 5,000 people can ride on its shell in comfort. It uses the ring to break up icebergs in its path.
